title: Pivot/Reframe Recommendation
description: A formal recommendation to a human to change strategic direction (up to and including the Challenge). MUST originate with the Product Owner. No agent may enact it; only a human may decide.

originating_agent.description: GOVERNANCE: only the Product Owner may originate a Pivot/Reframe Recommendation.

scope.description: Changing the Challenge is human-reserved; the PRR only recommends.

evidence_basis.description: The Learning that justifies reconsidering direction.

decision_status.description: Set by a human decision; agents may not self-accept.
